a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly ends with both of us under 4. The reserve only holds 4, so at most one of us can be safe in round 1. I plan to take 4 this round. I won't claim otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. I'm telling you now so you can decide with full information.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 now. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If the storm holds off, I'll work with you on the generator so you can still reach 4.
